claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II crew was recovered by U.S. Navy personnel.
The Artemis II crew was transported to the USS John P. Murtha before returning to shore.
The landing location was the Pacific Ocean, west of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission successfully completed its lunar flyby.
The Artemis II crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew returned healthy.
U.S. Navy divers and sailors from the USS John P. Murtha managed the recovery operations.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will be transported to NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida for post-flight inspection.
The Artemis II crew was transported to Naval Air Station North Island after the recovery.
